name: De Rucci Healthy Sleep Co., Ltd.
summary: De Rucci Healthy Sleep Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of healthy sleep systems in China, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers mattresses, bed frames, sofas, beddings, and its supporting home furnishings under the DeRUCCI, CALIAITALIA, CALIA, Envying the home, V6 Home Furnishings, Treca, Kluft, AIRELOOM, S&G Isueno, and SleepDesigns brands. It also engages in the provision of delivery, installation, repair, and maintenance; consulting; research and development; and investing services.
